subject: POC environment eligibility & ops commitments (draft MAP)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_n@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wong <alice@healthgrid.com>, infrastructure@healthgrid.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: POC environment eligibility & ops commitments (draft MAP)

Hi Alice / HealthGrid infra team,

Thanks for the time this morning — quick recap and a lightweight MAP draft focused on the POC infra milestone so we can align owners and unblock provisioning. I noted the high-priority dependencies we discussed and mapped proposed owners and next steps below. Please flag any incorrect owner assignments or missing items.

POC milestone: Environment readiness (target POC start window: 2027-12-06 -> target close for readiness: 2027-12-01)

Dependencies & proposed owners:
- VPC peering (peer connection + route propagation): HealthGrid infra (Alice / infrastructure@healthgrid.com) => Redwood ops contact (Marcus Lin) to exchange peer config and test window. Action: share peer CIDR + desired BGP/static route model.
- IP allowlist / NAT egress ranges: HealthGrid infra to confirm public egress ranges; Redwood will provide a recommended list for egress and callback IPs. Action: HealthGrid to send ranges by 2027-11-23.
- SSO / SAML integration: HealthGrid identity team (procurement/IT) to confirm IdP metadata; Redwood will provide SP metadata and test account instructions. Owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer (solutions). Owner (HealthGrid): Alice / IdP admin.
- Secrets / KMS access: HealthGrid security to confirm KMS policies or allow Redwood to create customer-managed key. Action: share policy template or grant cross-account key access by 2027-11-27.

Suggested immediate next steps:
1) HealthGrid to email the network ranges file and IdP metadata to this thread (due 2027-11-23).
2) Redwood (Marcus + Ben) to prepare VPC peering template and sample Security Group/IP allowlist (done and attached by our ops team).
3) Schedule a 30-minute infra handoff for week of 2027-11-29 to validate peering/SSO and run a quick connectivity smoke test.

Risks / notes:
- If IP allowlist ranges are delayed beyond 11/23, POC start may slip ~1 week.
- If HealthGrid requires a different KMS model (HSM-only), there will be a short runbook change and extra review time.

Attachments: sample peer template and KMS policy draft (placeholder — ops will attach in follow-up).

Would you like a single MAP row per dependency (owner / due date / status) or a one-pager checklist? I can convert this into a one-page MAP and drop a Drive link once you confirm owners.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya_n@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Alice Wong <alice@healthgrid.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_n@redwood.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: infrastructure@healthgrid.com, procurement@healthgrid.com
Date: 2027-11-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC environment eligibility & ops commitments (draft MAP)

Thanks, Priya — appreciate the clear list. A few clarifications from HealthGrid infra: 

- We'll attach the current egress and inbound CIDR list (internal) — sending network_ranges_v1.csv on this thread. Confirming target to deliver by 11/23.
- For peering: we prefer a static-route model (no BGP). Can Marcus share the expected routing table entries Redwood needs? Also confirm whether we need a NAT gateway on our side or if Redwood will NAT for callbacks.
- SSO: our IdP is Okta; procurement will provide the SP metadata (expect within 48 hours).
- KMS: preference is HealthGrid-managed CMK; we'll need a draft policy to review. If Redwood requires an alternative, call it out.

Action: infrastructure@healthgrid.com will review the peer template and confirm egress ranges by 2027-11-23. Procurement will circulate Okta metadata by 2027-11-22.

Alice Wong
Director, Platform Engineering | HealthGrid
alice@healthgrid.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_n@redwood.ai>, Alice Wong <alice@healthgrid.com>, infrastructure@healthgrid.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-20T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC environment eligibility & ops commitments (draft MAP)

Adding ops details and a couple clarifying items from our infra team.

Marcus (cc'd) will be our peering point-of-contact — Marcus, please confirm whether Redwood requires any specific ASN or we can provide a minimal peer config for the static-route path.

Quick notes:
- Redwood will NAT egress for hosted callbacks. We'll provide the public IP set (3 addresses) for allowlist. If HealthGrid runs deep inspection/whitelisting, we can optionally set up a dedicated egress IP range for this POC.
- Peering template attached (healthgrid_peer-template.tf) — this includes the minimal route and security-group examples. HealthGrid: please confirm the VPC/CIDR mapping and whether any overlapping CIDRs will need NAT translation.
- KMS: attached is a KMS policy draft (kms_key_policy-draft.pdf). If HealthGrid can grant cross-account key usage to the Redwood IAM role, we can proceed without creating a customer-managed key on our side. If you prefer HealthGrid-managed CMK, we’ll need the policy and principal ARN.

Proposed owners recap:
- VPC peering: HealthGrid infra (Alice) / Redwood ops (Marcus) — due 2027-11-24 (peer config exchanged)
- IP allowlist: HealthGrid infra (infrastructure@healthgrid.com) — due 2027-11-23
- SSO/SAML test: HealthGrid IdP admin (procurement/IT) / Redwood (Karthik) — metadata by 11/22, test by 11/29
- KMS policy/permissions: HealthGrid security (procurement@healthgrid.com) / Redwood ops (Marcus) — policy exchange by 11/27

I'll join the 11/29 handoff slot if we need an ops-level dial-in.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: healthgrid_peer-template.tf, kms_key_policy-draft.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wong <alice@healthgrid.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_n@redwood.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: infrastructure@healthgrid.com, procurement@healthgrid.com
Date: 2027-11-20T16:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC environment eligibility & ops commitments (draft MAP)

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation and next steps from Redwood's side: 

1) We'll convert Priya's draft into a single-line MAP (CSV + Drive copy) and share by EOD 2027-11-20 (Drive link will be posted here).
2) Redwood will provide the minimal callback IP list (3 IPs) by 2027-11-22 for HealthGrid to load into the allowlist.
3) Marcus to exchange the peering pre-shared config by 2027-11-24 and propose an 11/29 30-minute handoff slot (I’ll send a calendar invite for 11/29 10:00 AM PT).
4) Karthik to own the SSO test execution (once metadata is posted) and confirm success in the 11/29 handoff.

Target: environment ready for POC start the week of 2027-12-06. If owners meet the due dates above, we keep the target close; if any critical dependency slips, we will report a revised start date in the MAP.

Drive (MAP will be uploaded here): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-HealthGrid-POC
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HG-2027-1287

Thanks — looking forward to the handoff.
